drhp.business: Nandan Denim Limited is a flagship company of the Chiripal Group that manufactures denim fabric, shirting fabric and yarn through a vertically integrated manufacturing platform covering the entire value chain from spinning to fabric finishing. It serves domestic and international brands, exporters and buying houses, commenced operations in 1994 as a textile trading business and entered textile manufacturing in 2004.
